summary: Postal Realty Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K regarding entry into a Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement on July 2, 2026, as guarantor with its Operating Partnership as borrower and Truist Bank as agent. The agreement provides a $275 million senior unsecured revolving credit facility and $340 million in term loan facilities, including a new $35 million tranche. Borrowings are for general corporate purposes. This is a routine refinancing/credit facility amendment with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign.
